file.content: Reservation cash budget applies only to tier fees. Total cost is tier fees plus shipment charges plus deferred-order penalties. content.rules: Each customer must receive minimum_orders in EVERY scenario. Add the service credit indexed by the number of deferred orders ON TOP of individual deferral penalties. Add each used mode's activation fee ONCE per scenario, not per order. Minimize worst-case cost, then break ties by minimizing the sum of all scenario costs. Strict optimality is exact, with no regret allowance.
